# Puzzle Games

> Puzzle Games is an open-source suite of 304 minimalist brain-training and logic puzzle games built with Flutter. It runs in the browser and is free to play.

## Key facts

- 304 games across attention, logic, math, memory, spatial awareness and word categories.
- Built with Flutter (Dart), with targets for Web, Android, iOS, Linux, macOS and Windows.
- Includes well-known puzzles such as Sudoku, 2048, Minesweeper, Nonogram and Word Search.
- Licensed under GNU GPL v3.0.
- Original project: https://github.com/sidhant947/Puzzle

## Web deployment

- Live demo: https://vip-4.github.io/Puzzle/
- Built with `flutter build web --release --base-href /Puzzle/` and deployed to GitHub Pages.
